name: Ucup

statuses.parts-prepared: passed (parts extracted by semantic id, see parts_sheet.png)
statuses.rig-implemented: passed (FK hybrid vector cutout + IK authoring helper)
statuses.behavior-implemented: passed (20 s reel: idle, wave, explain, point, think/aha, thumbs/wink, recoil/shrug, hop)
statuses.motion-tested: passed for the front-view rig (reel rendered and inspected)
statuses.runtime-verified: NOT TESTED (no MEKANIVO Motion adapter built or verified)

source_format: procedural Python -> SVG (ucup_rig.py); ucup_rest.svg = rigged rest pose with semantic ids

rig.face: parametric: brows, eyes (open/arc/gaze), mouth (width/open/smile/skew), blush, sweat, mask

limitations: Front-view rig only. Side/back/3-4 views from the reference are not rebuilt; head turn is only a +-12px face slide.
No sit/crouch-seated or walk cycle (front-view foreshortening not solved).
Hands are simple flat shapes: no per-finger separation lines yet.
Reference proportions conflict (hero ~5 heads vs turnaround ~4.2); 4.5 chosen.
Pockets pose has no pocket overlay; hands just tuck under sleeve ends.
Cap/hair secondary motion is subtle (cap lag max ~2.5 deg).
Not loaded or verified in MEKANIVO Motion; not added to any shared library.
